- $x_i$ = number of units of product $i$ to order each day ($x_i \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$)

##### Objective Function

Maximize total benefit:
$$
\max \sum_{i=1}^{10} v_i x_i = 64x_1 + 75x_2 + 68x_3 + 11x_4 + 91x_5 + 31x_6 + 90x_7 + 56x_8 + 10x_9 + 24x_{10}
